description:
Meet the next evolution of the EVRYjourney E-Bike Rickshaw — engineered for families, riders, and adventurers who refuse to compromise on power or range. The 2026 Dual Motor Dual Battery Edition redefines what’s possible on three wheels: more torque, more distance, more capability. Whether you’re carrying passengers, cargo, or simply chasing new horizons, this is the e-bike built to go further and climb higher.

Key Upgrades

Dual 21Ah Batteries (42Ah Total Capacity)

Ride longer than ever before. With two high-capacity 21Ah batteries, you can cruise for miles without worrying about range anxiety. Ideal for long days on the road, errand runs, or full family outings. One battery located behind seat post and the other inside the top tube of frame. Can be charged even when connected to bike or can be removed to charge in location of your choice.

Dual 750W Motors (1500W Combined Power)

Unleash serious performance with a 750W rear motor and a 750W front hub motor. Choose between:

Rear-Drive Mode for smooth, efficient cruising.

Front-Drive Mode for extra traction on gravel or wet roads.

Dual-Drive Mode for maximum torque when climbing steep hills or carrying a full load.

This system gives you full control over your power and efficiency — on demand.

Hill-Climbing Torque, 500lb Capacity

With both motors engaged, the EVRYjourney Rickshaw conquers hills with confidence, even when fully loaded with two passengers or heavy cargo. Its combined 1500W system delivers immediate acceleration and stable torque where it matters most.

Top Speed: 20 MPH (Throttle or Pedal Assist)

Stay street-legal and enjoy a smooth, controlled ride. Use pedal assist for an easy workout, or engage throttle-only mode for effortless cruising.

Comfort & Utility

Signature EVRYjourney Step-Through Frame – Ultra-low entry for easy on/off access, even for riders with limited mobility.

Ergonomic Seating & Handlebars – Stay upright, comfortable, and relaxed mile after mile.

Passenger or Cargo-Ready Rear Section – Perfect for kids, groceries, or gear. Optional hitch attachment allows connection to trailers or accessories for expanded utility.

Hydraulic Disc Brakes – Confident stopping power even when fully loaded.

Fat Tires for All-Surface Stability – Smooth on pavement, steady on gravel, confident on grass or light trails.

Under seat storage w/ latch closure

Hitch attachment for optional seating or trailer attachments

Mirrors, Turn Signals and Flashers for safe riding

Why Riders Love It

Because it’s not just an e-bike — it’s a new category of personal mobility. The EVRYjourney Rickshaw combines the ease of an e-bike with the function of a family vehicle. With its dual-battery endurance and twin-motor strength, you’ll tackle steep neighborhoods, coastal hills, and long scenic routes with total confidence. Whether it’s school runs, errands, or weekend adventures, you’ll be gliding in quiet comfort and powerful control.
